data.title: How Google Cloud Put An AI Agent Inside Formula E’s GEN4 Car
data.description: At Goodwood Festival of Speed, Google Cloud and Formula E turned the new 815hp GEN4 into a moving AI laboratory, using a Pixel 10 Pro.
data.author: Bernard Marr
